exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to put, to place, to set, to stand, to station
to stop, to come to a stop, to pause, to pull up
to compel, to force, to make
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: постоя́нно — constantly, always; ста́вить — to put, to place, to set, to stand, to station; остана́вливаться — to stop, to come to a stop, to pause, to pull up; заставля́ть — to compel, to force, to make.
**остановлю** — останови́ть (perfective): to stop, to bring to stop; to stop short, to restrain; to fix, to direct, to concentrate. Wiktionary: о- + -станови́ть.
